verdicts.reason: Both reduce the grey/blue/red stripe backdrop to a meaningless thumbnail-sized chip, leave the URL rotated vertically at microscopic, unreadable size, shrink the product list to tiny fine print jammed against the right edge, and leave a large dead gap in the middle, so the brand and the reading order are lost. A also wraps 'for all drinkware on' onto two lines, set nearly as large as the price, so it competes with it. B keeps that line on one line beside the price, which gives clearer hierarchy and a more banner-like left-to-right read.
